analysis.title: Return Rate Impact Calculator
analysis.units: N cohort sales count; q fraction returned; P,C_sale,R,H,F,V currency per sale/return; profit and impact currency.

applicability.candidateDomain: N integer>=0; q in[0,1]; same recognition period; initial costs once; incremental return fees separate; recovery valuation basis explicit.
requiredChoices: Approve the sale/return cost boundary and separate cash versus inventory reporting?
Which recovery valuation, refund/fee events and recognition period apply?

analysis.limits: q0/q1; N0; recovered inventory not cash revenue; original retained processing fee not added again; impact sign defined q2 minusq1.

rounding.candidateWitnessArithmetic: Exact fractions; all literals rational; no money/grade rounding or tolerance chosen. Values such as82/25 may be rendered3.28 without rounding.

domainDefinitions: N integer>=0, q in[0,1], consistent cohort and recognition period.
C_sale contains initial per-sale costs exactly once, including original processing fees if applicable. A retained original fee is not a new incremental return charge.
F_incremental contains only additional return-specific charges not in C_sale or H_incremental. Fee reversals are explicit signed adjustments, never invented.
V_recovered is separately valued inventory recovery, not cash revenue; gross recovery less separate H or net recovery without repeating the same costs. Accounting compliance remains unasserted.

requiredChoices: Output precision, tie mode, intermediate versus final rounding, rate conversion and boundary comparisons must be explicitly selected; observed engine defaults are not approval.
